business: Nexio CRM (cloud CRM for small Uzbek companies)
target: Owner or sales head of a 3 to 15 person company in Uzbekistan that sells to other businesses or consumers and tracks clients in chats, spreadsheets, or amoCRM/Bitrix24
where: Tashkent and other cities of Uzbekistan

segments.name: Owner of a small shop or service business (3 to 6 staff)
Owner or sales head of a growing company (7 to 15 staff)
Head of sales at a larger firm (15 to 50 staff)

behaviours.name: Spreadsheet and Telegram user
behaviours.how: Tracks clients in Excel and Telegram chats, has never paid for a CRM.

behaviours.name: Unhappy amoCRM user
behaviours.how: Pays per seat for amoCRM, finds the bill growing and support slow.

behaviours.name: Bitrix24 user
behaviours.how: Uses Bitrix24 free or cheap plan, finds it heavy but familiar.

behaviours.name: Price comparer
behaviours.how: Checks three vendors, asks for the cheapest, wants a trial first.

behaviours.name: Trusts a recommendation
behaviours.how: Buys what a friend or partner already uses.

behaviours.name: Needs local payments
behaviours.how: Pays vendors in so'm through Click or Payme, avoids foreign cards.

behaviours.name: Wants it set up for them
behaviours.how: Has no time to migrate data or learn tools, pays for done-for-you.

objections: I do not know this company, it has no customers I can ask
I pay about $15 per user elsewhere and cannot see why a flat $89 is better
Moving my data from amoCRM or Excel will take weeks
Is the AI voice real or just a demo
Will it still exist and be supported in a year
My team will not learn another tool
I only need contacts and deals, not finance and inventory
habits: you answer most customers in Telegram and sometimes in Instagram
you take payments in cash, by Click or Payme, and by bank transfer
you ask your sales team to update a spreadsheet at the end of the day
you check prices in dollars but your clients pay you in so'm
